jobs.title: Belonging Report
jobs.description: CREATING SPACE TO THRIVE: GONG’S YEAR OF BELONGING, GROWTH, AND REPRESENTATION Sandi Kochhar Chief People Officer Published on: May 28, 2025 Last modified on: August 19, 2026 Table of contents Building inclusive communities and allyship Looking ahead to FY26 Expand Win more with Gong Preparing form... Fostering a culture of belonging is more than just an intention — it’s a continuous commitment to creating an environment where every employee feels seen, heard, and valued. It’s one thing to build a successful business and create raving fans. But it’s equally important to create a company whose employees truly enjoy coming to work and showing up as their authentic selves. This year, my role as Chief People Officer feels just as important as it has ever felt. While broader conversations around diversity have shifted over time, at Gong, our commitment to inclusivity and belonging has never been about trends. It’s a reflection of the global, culturally diverse community that has been core to our success from the very beginning. At its core, Gong is a company dedicated to helping businesses grow, and we apply that same philosophy to our culture. We’re deeply committed to fostering an environment where every Gongster can grow, thrive, and reach their full potential. The evidence is clear: when people can bring their authentic selves to work, their potential is unlocked, and we all become stronger. As we look back on our last fiscal year, we’re proud to our progress. Building inclusive communities and allyship We conducted our first Blueprint Maturity Assessment with an external partner. We are proud to that Gong outpaced industry benchmarks in leadership engagement around belonging. We were also included in the top tier of companies that regularly conduct pay equity analyses and of companies that currently have a belonging strategy. A thriving workplace begins with a strong community that facilitates connection. To ensure everyone feels they belong at Gong, we focused last year on amplifying diverse voices, celebrating cultural moments, and fostering connections. We achieved that through Gong Circles, more than 30 employee-led events designed to build safe spaces and support networks. Our Allyship Listen & Learn Series also provided curated educational programming to support diverse communities, with dedicated events. The impact of these programs is felt and in our last engagement survey, 77% of our Gongstersd they feel like they “Belong at Gong.” To continue to hold ourselves accountable to fair and equitable pay, we partnered with an outside consultant to conduct our fifth annual pay equity analysis. Through these initiatives, we continue to build a more inclusive workplace where fairness, transparency, and accountability are paramount. Looking ahead to FY26 As we move into FY26, Gong will continue driving initiatives that promote belonging, inclusion, and equity across our organization. We will continue our focused support for underrepresented communities through our Circles, mentorship, and professional development opportunities. Our journey toward belonging is a daily and ongoing effort, and we’re excited to continue building a workplace where everyone can thrive. Together, we can create a culture that not only supports but actively celebrates diversity, equity, and inclusion. Check out our previous Belong@Gong annual updates: FY24 , FY23 , FY22 , FY21 . Checkout our Ireland pay gap report. Sandi Kochhar Chief People Officer Sandi Kochhar is the Chief People Officer at Gong, where she leverages over two decades of leadership in scaling teams and driving operational excellence. Before Gong, Sandi held executive roles at Ripple, AppDirect, Atlassian, and SuccessFactors, contributing to global expansions, M&A integrations, and IPO preparations. With a background as a Global Six Sigma Black Belt at Honeywell, she combines operational expertise with strategic leadership to support fast-growing tech companies. jobs.title: Account Executive - Private Equity Sales San Francisco
jobs.description: Back to jobs Account Executive - Private Equity San Francisco Apply Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. As an Account Executive specifically for the Private Equity GTM Team, you’ll fill a key role in acquiring new customers and expanding current relationships. Gong has seen incredible success partnering with Private Equity firms to provide their portfolio companies with industry leading software. Out-of-the-box thinkers and those who will never settle for the status quo are strongly encouraged to apply! As a part of one of our newest segments, you will play a huge role in our company's growth while navigating your own individual growth journey as well. Being a champion of the entire sales process from start to finish, you will use your creative prospecting skills to strategically pursue net new business. Are you looking for the opportunity to make big waves & to perfect your craft of sales? We can’t wait to meet you! RESPONSIBILITIES Own the entire sales cycle from lead generation to close for Private Equity backed companies Land new business within greenfield territory using strategic outbound prospecting Close expansion opportunities within your current customer account base Clearly articulate and demonstrate our Gong value proposition, creating excitement and enthusiasm among prospects Engage and educate senior executives on the importance of the emerging Revenue Intelligence industry and validate Gong as the leader in this new market Partner with the SDR, Sales and Sales Engineering teams to develop account-based sales strategies to uncover value for all go-to-market department leaders You will sell directly to portfolio companies, while partnering closely with PE firms and their value creation teams to create lasting partnerships QUALIFICATIONS This role is hybrid, in San Francisco 3+ years of relevant sales experience preferably with a sales tech solution Familiarity with the Private Equity space and selling to portfolio companies is preferred Experience navigating large and complex organizations with multiple stakeholders Track record of overachieving revenue targets of 1M+ and successfully navigating and closing six-figure deals Previous SaaS experience, enterprise solutions preferred Excellent verbal and written communication skills Experience with Gong.io is preferred but not required PERKS & BENEFITS We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. Paid parental leave to support you and your family. Company-wide recharge days each quarter. Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment. The annual OTE for this position is $160,000 - $210,000 USD. Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets. We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect. We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored. Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. Want to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Gong’s ecosystem and be part of a new team in our Dublin R&D hub? The Comms Capture team is responsible for Gong's core data – the data pipeline that ingests and capture customer’s interactions from external communication systems (emails, calendars, phone/web conferencing calls, texts). These pipelines are online, are used by all of the company's customers, and forms the basis for a wide range of Gong's products. NOTE: This position is a hybrid-based role (Dublin office 3 days a week and remote 2 days) Dive into core, complex, large-scale backend systems. Understand how to implement new features, enhance existing capabilities, and resolve issues within a live, massive system without negatively impacting customers. Design and implement scalable, high-performance backend services and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and cloud technologies. Develop and maintain integration infrastructure, enabling third-party applications to seamlessly connect with Gong and extend its functionality. Build generic, modular API interfaces that support a wide range of future use cases, ensuring flexibility and reusability. Enhance system security, ensuring that Gong’s external-facing capabilities are both powerful and secure. Collaborate with internal teams (Product, GTM, and other R&D groups) and external partners to develop solutions that align with business and customer needs. Take full ownership of features from design to production, ensuring reliability, maintainability, and performance. Contribute to the strategic vision for Gong’s integration ecosystem, thinking beyond short-term tactical solutions. You should apply if you have... 5 + years of backend software development experience, with a strong foundation in Java and modern cloud-based architectures. Experience in both application and infrastructure development, with a deep understanding of scalable SaaS solutions. Strong proficiency in Java (Spring, etc.) and designing robust, maintainable APIs. Experience developing durable systems and using relevant technologies and techniques (kafka, SQS, etc.) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and building scalable microservices architectures. A solid understanding of secure API design and best practices for external integrations. Strong communication and collaboration skills- you'll work closely with partners, product teams, and developers across multiple organizations. Ability to take ownership and drive projects forward independently. We are looking for someone who isn't afraid to delve into an existing code base and complex systems, loves to refactor, shape new architecture, think outside the box, and suggest innovative architectural and product solutions. What makes Engineering at Gong unique? Here at Gong, we trust and empower our employees with ownership to solve complex problems, make the right decisions, and build the best products that create radical impact. We call this “Own. Solve. Impact.” For our engineers, it means it's not just about writing code. You are involved and able to influence the entire process to create the best product. Perks & Benefits We offer Gongsters a variety of private health insurance plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. Paid parental leave to support you and your family. Company-wide recharge days each quarter. The Gong Revenue AI Platform captures and contextualizes customer interactions, surfaces insights and predictions, and powers actions and workflows that are essential for business success. More than 4,500 companies around the world rely on Gong to unlock their revenue potential. For more information, visit www.gong.io. Expression of Interest – Business Development Representative, Australia Market As we continue our growth across APAC, we're hiring a Business Development Representative to drive new business generation across Australia. This role is based in Sydney and sits within our Business/Sales Development organization, working closely with Account Executives to build pipeline across the Australia market. This is an Expression of Interest, not a live job posting yet. We're moving quickly to identify the right person, so if this sounds like you, we'd rather hear from you now than after the role goes public. Who we're looking for We need someone who thrives on the energy of outbound prospecting and isn't afraid of the phone. You'll be the first point of contact for prospective Australian customers, sparking interest in Gong through cold calls, emails, and social outreach, and turning cold conversations into qualified discovery calls for our Account Executives. You should be someone who gets a charge out of high-volume, high-activity work, who takes ownership of their own book of accounts, and who's looking to build a foundation for a long-term career in sales. Given our growth plans, we're looking for someone who can ramp quickly and bring energy and resilience from day one. What you'll do Generate interest and awareness for Gong through cold calling, email, and social outreach to prospective Australian customers Schedule qualified initial discovery calls for Account Executives Consistently meet or exceed daily activity targets (80–100 activities) Own and strategically manage a dedicated book of Australian accounts Become a power user of the Gong platform Share feedback and insights with BDR Managers and Sales Enablement to help improve team effectiveness Collaborate with peers across the region to exchange and apply best practices What we look for Prior prospecting or sales experience is a plus, but not essential — we care more about drive than resume A genuine passion for sales, or an interest in building a long-term sales career Curious about AI — you're experimenting, testing tools, and finding an edge using AI Strong verbal and written communication skills High resilience — comfortable with rejection and quick to bounce back A growth mindset and genuine coachability — open to feedback and eager to improve Comfort with high-activity, high-volume outbound work Based in Sydney What happens next You submit your expression of interest (about 5 minutes) Our Talent team reviews submissions on a rolling basis Strong-fit candidates are contacted directly for an initial conversation, ahead of any public posting If there's mutual fit, we move into a full interview process Gong is an equal-opportunity employer.
